title: No Chest
description: This mod removes all chests from Minecraft, so you can’t craft or place them anywhere. Storage becomes way harder, and you have to rely on other methods to keep your items safe.
body: No Chests deletes regular chests, trapped chests, chest minecarts, and all chest-related generation. Loot chests in structures don’t spawn, villagers don’t use them, and you can’t craft one yourself. Without chests, players have to store items with barrels, shulkers (if allowed), or carry everything. It makes survival tougher, exploration riskier, and early-game inventory management way more stressful.
